resources.string: Phone notifications on the tablet
Forward every app\'s notifications between Xiaomi devices (Interconnectivity) and let them pop up on the tablet.
Xiaomi reply box
Xiaomi\'s reply box and buttons for Telegram, WhatsApp and every other notification (formerly XReply). Uninstall XReply if it is still installed.
Live charging power on the island
The charging island shows the power going into the battery right now (for example 27 W), updated every second, instead of only the charger maximum.
Music island follows the song
The bars on the music island move with the song playing (bass to treble) in the album art colours, instead of a fixed animation.
Particle clear animation
Tapping clear all dissolves the notifications into drifting particles instead of sliding them away.
Changes apply after a reboot (or after restarting System UI and Interconnectivity).
